title: Xanthohumol ameliorates OVA-induced allergic asthma by inhibiting AIM2 inflammasome activation.
authors: Chen, Wushi; Shen, Yunqin; Jia, Hongyun; Hou, Shanshan; Li, Lingjie; Huang, Lixia; Cai, Jiyi; Xing, Yuhan; Chen, Yanqiu; Yang, Yan
one_liner_zh: 该文研究黄腐酚通过抑制AIM2炎症小体改善过敏性哮喘，虽涉及分子对接但核心为疾病药理机制，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题无关。
abstract: ETHNOPHARMACOLOGICAL RELEVANCE: Humulus lupulus L., an herb traditionally employed in medicinal practices across North America, Egypt, India, and China, demonstrates broad therapeutic properties, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, hepatoprotective, and diuretic effects. Xanthohumol (XN), a prenylated flavonoid derived from Humulus lupulus L., retains these anti-inflammatory and antioxidant activities. However, its potential efficacy in allergic asthma remains largely unexplored. AIM OF THE STUDY: This study aimed to investigate the protective properties of XN against allergic asthma and to elucidate the underlying mechanisms, particularly the role of Absent in Melanoma 2 (AIM2), an innate immune sensor, in allergic asthma and its modulation by XN. MATERIALS AND METHODS: The OVA-induced murine model of allergic asthma with XN administration in different dosages was constructed to evaluate the regulatory effects of XN on allergic asthma, particularly during the period of acute attack. Pathological alterations, T-cell polarization, inflammatory cytokine profiles, and oxidative stress markers were systematically assessed. Bioinformatic analysis, clinical case-control, and molecular docking combined with cellular thermal shift assay (CETSA) were applied to identify the specific target of XN to execute its effects. Human bronchial epithelial (16HBE) cell models with various stimulations and treatments were used in this study to verify the mechanistic exploration. RESULTS: In allergic asthmatic mice, the results demonstrated that XN dose-dependently attenuated airway inflammation and immune balance, characterized by reduced inflammatory cell infiltration, cytokine production, IgE secretion, and Th2 immune response. AIM2 was recognized as a critical binding target of xanthohumol through database analysis, molecular docking, and CETSA. Clinically, elevated serum AIM2 levels in asthma patients correlated positively with eosinophil percentage, IgE levels, and systemic immune inflammation index (SII). Mechanistically, both in vivo and in vitro studies revealed that XN mitigated oxidative stress and mitochondrial dysfunction, thereby reducing double-stranded DNA release, a key activator of the AIM2 inflammasome. Moreover, XN dose-dependently suppressed AIM2 inflammasome activation, an effect further validated in Poly (dA:dT)-stimulated and AIM2-silenced 16HBE cells. CONCLUSION: This study provides the first evidence implicating XN can improve OVA-induced allergic asthma by suppressing AIM2 inflammasome activation, highlighting XN as a promising therapeutic candidate for allergic asthma.
abstract_zh: 民族药理学相关性：啤酒花（Humulus lupulus L.）是一种在北美、埃及、印度和中国传统医学实践中使用的草药，具有广泛的治疗特性，包括抗炎、抗氧化、保肝和利尿作用。黄腐酚（Xanthohumol, XN）是从啤酒花中提取的一种异戊二烯化黄酮类化合物，保留了这些抗炎和抗氧化活性。然而，其在过敏性哮喘中的潜在疗效尚未得到充分探索。研究目的：本研究旨在探讨XN对过敏性哮喘的保护作用，并阐明其潜在机制，特别是黑色素瘤缺失因子2（Absent in Melanoma 2, AIM2）——一种先天免疫传感器——在过敏性哮喘中的作用及其受XN的调节。材料与方法：构建了不同剂量XN给药的OVA诱导的过敏性哮喘小鼠模型，以评估XN对过敏性哮喘的调节作用，尤其是在急性发作期间。系统评估了病理变化、T细胞极化、炎症细胞因子谱和氧化应激标志物。结合生物信息学分析、临床病例对照研究、分子对接和细胞热位移分析（cellular thermal shift assay, CETSA），以确定XN发挥其作用的具体靶点。本研究使用人支气管上皮（16HBE）细胞模型，通过不同刺激和处理来验证机制探索。结果：在过敏性哮喘小鼠中，结果表明XN剂量依赖性地减轻了气道炎症和免疫失衡，表现为炎症细胞浸润、细胞因子产生、IgE分泌和Th2免疫反应减少。通过数据库分析、分子对接和CETSA，AIM2被确认为黄腐酚的关键结合靶点。临床上，哮喘患者血清AIM2水平升高与嗜酸性粒细胞百分比、IgE水平和全身免疫炎症指数（systemic immune inflammation index, SII）呈正相关。机制上，体内和体外研究均表明，XN减轻了氧化应激和线粒体功能障碍，从而减少了双链DNA释放——AIM2炎症小体的关键激活因子。此外，XN剂量依赖性地抑制了AIM2炎症小体激活，这一效应在Poly (dA:dT)刺激和AIM2沉默的16HBE细胞中得到了进一步验证。结论：本研究首次提供证据表明，XN可通过抑制AIM2炎症小体激活来改善OVA诱导的过敏性哮喘，凸显了XN作为过敏性哮喘有前景的治疗候选药物的潜力。
